verdict.rationale: Docs say composition functions can be written in several languages, including Python and Go, and the official CLI can test and render functions locally. That points to supported programmatic extension, but the evidence never explicitly names an official SDK, so the support is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs (e.g. function SDKs for Go/Python) and their API coverage, client SDKs for driving Crossplane APIs programmatically, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
